section: Tall unit top elements H. 60 | without fixings
source_pages: printed p.172 / PDF 174 (taken WHOLE - three positions)
family_naming_note: Joins the name catalog_map already used. Prefix SD; the run SB/SC/SD/SE against H.36/H.48/H.60/H.72 is the only alphabetical run of family letters in this catalog and is still read from the row.
extraction_note: printed p.172 taken WHOLE 2026-08-25, and taken because of a REMARK rather than a plan: Andriy said the top doors must open to the side, not upward. printed p.170 and p.173 - the two heights already held - sell only a top-hung door. THIS PAGE AND printed p.171 ARE THE ONLY ONES THAT SELL A SIDE-HINGED TOP ELEMENT, which is why the four pages of this chapter are not one page at four heights. 3 positions, 9 codes, d.62, verified against a 150-dpi render. printed p.171 (SC, H.48) remains unread.
side_hinged_width_note: THE SIDE-HINGED SINGLE DOOR STOPS AT W.60. Position 2 prints SD0531 at W.45 and SD0631 at W.60 and nothing wider; above that the side-hinged option is the TWO-door position, W.90 and W.120. CONSEQUENCE, WRITTEN DOWN BECAUSE IT DECIDES A LAYOUT: a 610 side-hinged single door cannot be made. Modifications reduce, and there is no side-hinged single door above 600 to reduce FROM.

data.plinth_note: ZERO, AND IT HAS TO BE STATED. Generator.plinth_h_mm defaults to Standards::PLINTH_H_MM when a family is silent. A top element stands on the tall unit below it, so silence would draw it a 100 mm plinth in mid-air. Learned on tall_top_h36/h72 the same day.
data.mounting_note: NO `mounting` VALUE, AND THE ABSENCE IS A READING. 'without fixings': this element rests on the tall unit beneath it and meets neither the floor nor the wall, which are the only two values Object Contract v2.1 allows. See tall_top_h72.json for the full argument.
data.depth_note: d.62 only - one label serves all three code tables and no second band is printed.
data.source_ref: CESAR - 2 Kitchen System.pdf printed p.172 / PDF 174
data.n_elle_note: printed p.172 carries 'N- Elle' and 62,2 in its TEXT LAYER and prints neither. NOT PRINTED, verified the way the wall chapter's was on 2026-08-23: rendering the page at 600 dpi and cropping exactly where pdftotext puts the string shows blank paper. White text, or a hidden layer for the N_Elle edition - IN THE FILE, NOT IN THE BOOK. Third chapter to do it. DOCUMENT LEAD BELOW SOURCE TRUST: used for nothing, drawn by nothing, never quoted to Elda as something the catalog prints.
